title: MemVerse: Multimodal Memory for Lifelong Learning Agents
abstract: arXiv:2512.03627v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Despite the remarkable advancements in multimodal large language models across various domains, AI agents still lack the ability to retain past information. Without reliable memory, agents struggle to leverage historical context, impairing long-horizon reasoning and coherent interactions in dynamic environments. In this paper, we introduce MemVerse, a model-agnostic, plug-and-play memory framework that combines fast parametric recall with hierarchical retrieval, enabling scalable and adaptive multimodal intelligence. MemVerse maintains short-term memory for recent context while transforming raw experiences into structured long-term memory graphs, empowering continuous learning and autonomous knowledge evolution. translated_title: MemVerse：面向终身学习智能体的多模态记忆
translated_abstract: 尽管多模态大语言模型在各个领域取得了显著进展，但AI智能体仍然缺乏保留过去信息的能力。没有可靠的记忆，智能体难以利用历史上下文，从而损害了动态环境中的长程推理能力和连贯交互。在本文中，我们提出了MemVerse，一个模型无关、即插即用的记忆框架，它将快速参数化召回与分层检索相结合，实现可扩展且自适应的多模态智能。MemVerse在为近期上下文维护短期记忆的同时，将原始经验转化为结构化的长期记忆图，从而支持持续学习和自主知识演化。为满足实时需求，我们引入了一种周期性蒸馏机制，将认知图中的关键知识压缩到参数模型中，在提供快速且可微分的记忆召回的同时保留……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了MemVerse——一个模型无关、即插即用的多模态记忆框架，通过短期记忆、结构化长期记忆图和周期性知识蒸馏机制，使终身学习智能体能够实现快速召回、持续学习与自主知识演化。
en_tdlr: MemVerse is a model-agnostic, plug-and-play multimodal memory framework that combines short-term memory, structured long-term memory graphs, and periodic knowledge distillation to enable fast recall, continuous learning, and autonomous knowledge evolution for lifelong learning agents.
